Set `expand=True` on the table and `ratio=1` on the Biography column to allocate the remaining table width to it. Keep `no_wrap=True` and `overflow="ellipsis"` on that column. The [table docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst) explain table expansion and column ratios. For usage questions, please ask in [Rich Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
